issue.description:
Auto-split child of beadrs-5a0dc962; depends on the invariant test, so the docs only canonize a proven script.

Rewrite BUILD_PROCEDURE.md and AGENTS.md in /home/coding/bead-rs:
- State the rule in one sentence: pinned binaries are built from a git-archive extraction in scratch via scripts/build-from-archive.sh; the shared checkout is never stashed, reset or checked out for a build.
- Name the script as the only sanctioned way to produce a pinned binary.
- Remove every instruction that stashes, resets or checks out inside the shared tree to build or pin a binary — including any text telling a builder to switch branches or clean the working tree first.
- Keep the historical context (the 2026-09-01/09-02 incident) brief: what happened and why the rule exists, per ADR-015 in NEEDLE.

Acceptance:
- grep over BUILD_PROCEDURE.md and AGENTS.md finds no surviving instruction to stash, reset or checkout in the shared checkout for build purposes.
- Both documents reference scripts/build-from-archive.sh by path and describe the scratch cleanup contract (removed on success, kept on failure).

Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962.

## Scope
Re-run leg (b) of the parent stranger test — a cargo install --git build of current main — and finalize scoped item 3 of parent beadrs-5e2144e8: confirm no Quick start command depends on main-only behaviour, or adjust the Quick start so it works on both binaries / mark the step as needing main. Record which choice was made; the parent close cites this bead.

## Base directory rule (same trap as the installer leg)
No .beads in any ancestor of the scratch base — ~/scratch symlinks into /data/build/scratch which holds a stray .beads store that discovery silently adopts. Verify /data/build, /data and / are clean, then mktemp under /data/build.

## Script shape
```bash
set -euo pipefail
d=$(mktemp -d /data/build/stranger-clean-git.XXXXXX)
trap 'rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then rm -rf "$d"; else echo "kept $d for diagnosis" >&2; fi' EXIT
env -u BEAD_ORG_SECRET_SCANNER bash -euo pipefail -c '
  cargo install --git https://github.com/jedarden/bead-rs --bin bead --root "'"$d"'/cargo"
  PATH="'"$d"'/cargo/bin:$PATH" bead --version        # expect the main-tip version (0.3.0 line)
  mkdir -p "'"$d"'/ws" && cd "'"$d"'/ws" && git init -q
  # ONLY the README Quick start, copied verbatim
'
```
cargo install --git builds from the public mirror and may take several minutes; the binary must come from git HEAD via --root into $d/cargo, not from a local build.

## Acceptance (paste outputs on this bead)
- cargo install --git exits 0; bead --version prints the main-tip version (0.3.0 line as of 2026-10-26).
- Quick start output pasted; same lifecycle expectations as the installer leg (design + docs ready first, store joins after close).
- Fresh-workspace proof (new UUID at your $d/ws, no "Workspace already exists").
- The works-on-both decision recorded explicitly. Baseline from attempt 2 (2026-10-26): NO Quick start command failed on released v0.2.6, including close ... --fencing-token 1 (the first claim of a fresh workspace is epoch 1, which v0.2.6 accepts); nothing was marked as needing main and no follow-up release bead is required. Either re-confirm that with this run, or — if something now fails on either binary — adjust the README Quick start (pushed commit, README.md only) or mark the step main-only and file the follow-up bead the parent names.
- Close-gate note: the gate re-runs your verified block under the captured worker env — keep TMPDIR a real existing dir in the evidence script; if you cite cargo, keep the claim concise (version plus one lifecycle command), never a full cold build.
- No .github/workflows/*, no src/ changes, no release cut, no AGENTS.md / CI-badge / pinned-binaries/ / .marathon/ / man/ edits.

## Shared-checkout warning
Rival beadrs-e4acee24 WIP sits uncommitted in src/ and tests/. If you edit README.md, stage only README.md; commit and push in one invocation.

issue.description:
ADR-002 replaces migration import with agent-guided rehydration: the agent creates native beads via public CLI only and produces a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native id or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording source repository and commit, never accepted as store input. No open bead defines that report's schema, versioning, or validation; the ADR also notes large repositories need batching, resumability, and duplicate detection. Work: author the versioned report schema (spec + minimal example), document it beside the field guide, and add a read-only validation check so a rehydration run is reviewable; explicitly keep the format out of the native store input path.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Specify the agent-guided rehydration reconciliation report format (ADR-002)

issue.description:
Parent: the R041 umbrella (agent-friction:umbrella). Implements R041 decision 6 as specified by the spec child. Blocked by the claim-credential child, which also edits the label argument definitions.

Problem: `bead label add ID LABEL` is the form agents type by default; it fails with `unexpected argument` (~60 errors, e.g. `verification-failed`, `failure-count:1`, `blocked`), and label remove has a 9.7% error rate.

Scope: `label add|remove ID LABEL...` accepts one or more positional labels alongside the existing `--label` (the NEEDLE contract rows stay valid).

Acceptance:
- `label add ID a b` and `label remove ID a b` apply in one transaction and stay idempotent.
- `--label` keeps working, and mixing the forms works.
- No label at all is a usage error that names both forms.
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test pass.
issue.title: Accept positional labels on label add and label remove
